title.text:
India's international market reaches 96M to 109M passengers by 2030, up from 78M
Millions of international sector passengers in 2030, against 78.0M in 2025. The band is reported, never the average. Capacity leg counts 46,546 seats on firm order at published two-class layouts, flown at 10.06 hours per aircraft per day (owned fleet basis; an active-fleet basis would be materially higher). Variant assumed for 10x A350-900 (Air India) and 20x 787-9 (Air India)
